decisions.title: Reused verdicts are re-checked for independence against the live author
decisions.rationale: A stored verdict bound before the author was known could otherwise pass a self-review.

decisions.title: The cheap-path placeholder review is bound too
decisions.rationale: Every stored review then carries a binding, so schema 1.2 validation and later currency checks have one shape to handle.

decisions.title: Suites run as separate pytest invocations
decisions.rationale: A single combined collection hits a pre-existing duplicate-conftest plugin registration clash unrelated to this change.
